name: Villores (Spain)
description: Green field charged with a grey ox passant surmounted by a grey six-pointed star.
history: The flag was approved by resolution of 3 May 2001 of the conseller de Justícia i Administracions Públiques, published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat Valenciana; it is a flag of 2:3, green, with an ox passant grey surmounted by a six-pointed star of the same colour, from the immemorial arms with the armorials of the Antolí (the star) and the Borràs (the ox), former lords of the village.

features.role: ox passant, the arms of the Borràs
